title: Summer Sweets
body:
Hey hey! These resourcepacks use custom model data and the item models can be summoned with commands, no mods required! 

Perfect for decorating ice cream parlors, beachsides, and more!


**Commands for 1.19.3+**

Sunset Parfait
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:168}

Matcha Ice Creamroll
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:169}

Berry Boba
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:170}

Honey Blackberry Ice Cream
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:171}

Color Ink Sorbet
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:172}

Snowcone
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:173}

Seafoam Parfait
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:174}

Sunset Sorbet
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:175}

Sesame Taiyaki
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:176}

Berry Lemon Smoothie
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:177}

Berry Bowl
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:178}

Cotton Candy Sundae
/give @s cooked_beef{CustomModelData:179}
